title: Superfluidity in topologically nontrivial flat bands
one_line: 奠基性论文：拓扑非平凡平带中超流权重来自量子几何而非动能
why: 整个D7方向的理论起点（arXiv ID 由主会话核实）

title: Superconductivity, superfluidity and quantum geometry in twisted multilayer systems
one_line: 莫尔多层体系量子几何超导的权威综述
why: 领域内最常被引用的中期综述

title: Quantum geometry in superfluidity and superconductivity
venue: Proc. Int. School Physics Enrico Fermi Vol. 211, 373-404
one_line: 最新理论全景综述，明确给出平带超流权重正比于最小量子度规
why: 当前最系统的理论综述

title: Revisiting flat band superconductivity: dependence on minimal quantum metric and band touchings
one_line: 提出最小量子度规概念，修正此前平均场超流权重推导的不完整性
why: 几乎所有后续量子几何超导定量工作的方法论基础

title: Superfluid stiffness of magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene
one_line: 首次直接测量MATBG超流刚度，比传统预期大约10倍，与量子几何理论一致（arXiv 版标题为 'Superfluid Stiffness and Flat-Band Superconductivity in Magic-Angle Graphene Probed by cQED'；第一作者 Miuko Tanaka，agent 原写 Hiori 有误）
why: 量子几何理论第一个直接的定量实验验证

title: Superfluid stiffness of twisted trilayer graphene superconductors
one_line: MATTG超流刚度测量，超导转变由相位涨落而非库珀对拆对控制
why: 与Tanaka et al.同期姊妹论文

title: Superfluid stiffness bounds in time-reversal symmetric superconductors
one_line: 给出超流刚度严格上下界；关键反例：菱方多层石墨烯中几何贡献不主导
why: '量子几何非普适材料筛选量'的直接理论依据

title: Experimental evidence for nodal superconducting gap in moiré graphene
one_line: MATTG同时隧穿谱+输运测量，能隙线性填充+Volovik效应指向节点序参量
why: 证伪简单各向同性s波BCS图像

title: Molecular Pairing in Twisted Bilayer Graphene Superconductivity
one_line: 类比A3C60分子超导，动态Jahn-Teller声子机制克服库仑排斥
why: 声子阵营的代表性理论

title: Coulomb screening of superconductivity in magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene
one_line: 双层解耦莫尔器件屏蔽实验：屏蔽邻层可完全抑制超导+关联绝缘体，支持非常规配对
why: 配对机制之争的关键2026年实验证据之一

title: Upper bounds on superconducting and excitonic phase-stiffness for interacting isolated narrow bands
one_line: 无需Wannier化的投影规范变换法给出相干长度/相位刚度严格上界
why: 问题1的直接方法论来源

title: Ginzburg-Landau Theory of Flat-Band Superconductors with Quantum Metric
one_line: 相干长度由量子度规限制的最优局域Wannier函数尺寸决定，而非费米速度
why: 解释了MATBG反常相干长度的关键理论框架

title: Superconductivity in Twisted WSe2 from Topology-Induced Quantum Fluctuations
authors_short: Xie, Chen, Sur, Fang, Cano, Si
one_line: 拓扑活性平带+邻近宽带的紧凑分子轨道产生量子涨落，弱化静态序
why: 转角WSe2四种竞争理论之一（agent 未核实 arXiv ID）

title: Theory of intervalley-coherent antiferromagnetic order and topological superconductivity in twisted bilayer WSe2
one_line: 谷间相干AFM序理论解释twisted WSe2超导邻近的关联绝缘态
why: 转角WSe2竞争理论之一

title: Signatures of unconventional superconductivity near reentrant and fractional quantum anomalous Hall insulators (twisted MoTe2)
one_line: 转角MoTe2中从FQAH绝缘体邻近区域观测到非常规超导迹象
why: 转角MoTe2手性拓扑超导理论工作的实验触发点

title: From fractionalization to chiral topological superconductivity in a flat Chern band
one_line: 从FQAH分数化态到手性拓扑超导的理论路径，应用于twisted MoTe2
why: 代表'分数化→超导'新颖图像

title: Band-basis decomposition of superfluid weight in magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene: Quantifying geometric and conventional contributions
one_line: 系统量化MATBG几何/常规贡献占比：平带极限22-26%，全带~55-58%
why: 问题2的直接方法论基础

title: Crystal net catalog of model flat band materials
one_line: 对Materials Project 13.9万材料做高通量平带筛选，得到6.3万含平带候选
why: 问题1的核心数据来源，目前最系统的平带材料候选池

title: Quantum geometry and impurity sensitivity of superconductors without time-reversal symmetry: application to rhombohedral graphene and altermagnets
one_line: 首次将量子几何框架系统用于无时间反演对称的超导体（含altermagnet）
why: 问题4的唯一直接前置工作

title: Catalogue of flat-band stoichiometric materials
one_line: 对55206种ICSD材料做拓扑量子化学分类的平带材料目录
why: 高通量平带筛选的奠基性数据库
